issues.detail: The Greek 'παραβολην επεχων' (having told/spoken a parable) is followed by the content of the parable, but the Vietnamese 'để ý cách họ chọn chỗ ngồi cao nhất' (noticing how they chose the highest seats) misinterprets the structure. The Greek describes the *content* of the parable being told (how the first-seated were told...), not an observation of the listeners' behavior in the moment.
